artifact_observations.reasoning: The lettering on the jersey is structurally incoherent. It resembles letters but fails to form legible words or a recognizable team logo, exhibiting classic AI-generated text artifacts where character shapes melt into one another.

The anatomy of the throwing arm is slightly ambiguous. The sleeve folds and the transition from shoulder to elbow lack clear structural definition, appearing somewhat 'mushy' or fused, though not catastrophically broken.

While a pitcher releases the ball, the complete absence of a fielding glove on the non-throwing hand (which is tucked against the body) is suspicious. The hand itself is poorly defined, blending into the jersey fabric.

alignment_reasoning: The image correctly identifies the general class 'ballplayer' and captures a plausible pitching pose. These failures significantly reduce alignment with the specific 'baseball player' definition which requires standard equipment and uniform details.
